# Sidebar rows' second line (sidebar-rows = comfortable, the default):
# what a program reports, else the branch and its changes (tests/run.sh
# makes the repository at @REPO@ with one line added), else the folder
# (when the first line doesn't say it already).
# The pane header says the branch too.
size:1100x600
# A shell at its prompt says its folder once: "zsh ~" (bash on CI), no
# second "~" under it.
type:cd ~
key:enter
wait:1.5
expect-tab: · ~
expect-tab-not:2: ~
# A program's title names the tab while it runs, and goes when it does
# (OMP's "π > tmp" stayed after quitting it): the shell and folder again.
type:printf '\033]2;OMP > tmp\a'; sleep 2
key:enter
wait:1.0
expect-tab:OMP > tmp
wait:2.5
expect-tab-not:OMP > tmp
expect-tab: · ~
expect-tab-not:2: ~
# A title a background job sets at the prompt is the shell's: it stays.
type:(sleep 0.5; printf '\033]2;MINE\a') &
key:enter
wait:2.0
expect-tab:MINE
type:printf '\033]2;\a'
key:enter
wait:1.0
type:cd @REPO@
key:enter
wait:5.0
expect-tab:main +1
expect-header:main +1
# A program's message comes first while it reports one.
type:printf '\033]7501;state=working:app=probe:msg=TWVyZ2luZyB0aGUgYnJhbmNo\a'; sleep 30
key:enter
wait:1.5
expect-tab:Merging the branch
# At its least width the sidebar still fits its top row: the toggle after the
# traffic lights, Show Activity, the palette and New Tab, none on another.
sidebar-width:120
